name: plugin.vector_index
description: Local semantic vector index, natural language code/doc retrieval, and hybrid search

entrypoints.name: vector_index_directory
entrypoints.description: Scan and index source code or markdown documents in a directory for semantic search

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: List of file extensions to index (e.g. ['.py', '.md', '.json'], default: python & markdown)

entrypoints.name: vector_search_semantic
entrypoints.description: Perform natural language semantic cosine search over the indexed chunks

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top results to return (default: 5)

entrypoints.name: vector_search_hybrid
entrypoints.description: Perform hybrid lexical + semantic search combining exact keyword and vector ranking

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top results to return (default: 5)
